blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Non-Moro Indigenous Peoples (IP) leaders have called on the kin of slain IPs, estimated to reach 110 individuals in the past several years, to refrain from retaliating, calling on the government to bring justice to their deaths and strengthen safety measures for tribal leaders and communities. The appeal came amid the fresh killings of Teduray leader Joel Magtud, a village councilor of Barangay Mahantao, Datu Hoffer, Maguindanao del Sur, who was gunned down on Saturday evening, October 17, in Datu Unsay town; and Cyril Tomas, a Teduray farmer from Barangay Limpogo, Datu Hoffer, who was shot the following […]...
